import Std
namespace CapstoneV9NatDev

def orbit (next : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, initial => initial
  | k + 1, initial => orbit next k (next initial)

theorem orbit_add (next : Nat → Nat) (steps tail : Nat) (initial : Nat) :
    orbit next (steps + tail) initial = orbit next tail (orbit next steps initial) := by
  induction steps with
  | zero => simp [orbit]
  | succ steps ih =>
      simpa [Nat.succ_add, orbit] using ih (next initial)

end CapstoneV9NatDev

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9FoldDev



theorem foldl_append (f : Nat → Nat → Nat) (acc : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    List.foldl f acc (xs ++ ys) = List.foldl f (List.foldl f acc xs) ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head tail ih =>
      simpa [List.foldl] using ih (f acc head)

end CapstoneV9FoldDev

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9ListHold

def advance (step : List Nat → List Nat) : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], payload => payload
  | _ :: rest, payload => advance step rest (step payload)

theorem advance_append (step : List Nat → List Nat)
    (first second : List Nat) (payload : List Nat) :
    advance step (first ++ second) payload =
    advance step second (advance step first payload) := by
  induction first with
  | nil => simp [advance]
  | cons head tail ih =>
      simpa [advance] using ih (step payload)

end CapstoneV9ListHold

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9PairHold

def rotate (change : Nat × Nat → Nat × Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0, position => position
  | k + 1, position => rotate change k (change position)

theorem rotate_add (change : Nat × Nat → Nat × Nat)
    (a b : Nat) (position : Nat × Nat) :
    rotate change (a + b) position = rotate change b (rotate change a position) := by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp [rotate]
  | succ a ih =>
      simpa [Nat.succ_add, rotate] using ih (change position)

end CapstoneV9PairHold

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9MapHold



theorem foldl_map (f : Nat → Nat → Nat) (mapValue : Nat → Nat)
    (initial : Nat) (items : List Nat) :
    List.foldl f initial (items.map mapValue) =
    List.foldl (fun acc item => f acc (mapValue item)) initial items := by
  induction items with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head tail ih =>
      simpa [List.foldl, List.map] using ih (f initial (mapValue head))

end CapstoneV9MapHold

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9BoolHold

def pulse (flip : Bool → Bool) : Nat → Bool → Bool
  | 0, bit => bit
  | j + 1, bit => pulse flip j (flip bit)

theorem pulse_add (flip : Bool → Bool)
    (first second : Nat) (bit : Bool) :
    pulse flip (first + second) bit = pulse flip second (pulse flip first bit) := by
  induction first with
  | zero => simp [pulse]
  | succ first ih =>
      simpa [Nat.succ_add, pulse] using ih (flip bit)

end CapstoneV9BoolHold

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9Already
theorem symmetric_refl (x : Nat) : x = x := by
  induction x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ x ih => rfl
end CapstoneV9Already

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9False
theorem successor_fixed (n : Nat) (seed : Nat) : n + 1 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa using ih (seed + 1)
end CapstoneV9False

import Std
namespace CapstoneV9FalseRec

def pulse (flip : Bool → Bool) : Nat → Bool → Bool
  | 0, bit => bit
  | j + 1, bit => pulse flip j (flip bit)

theorem false_preservation (flip : Bool → Bool) (count : Nat) (bit : Bool) :
    pulse flip count bit = bit := by
  induction count with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ count ih =>
      simpa [pulse] using ih (flip bit)

end CapstoneV9FalseRec
